stories.title: Deterministic partial fill model
acceptance: Entry fill uses participation cap and emits fill_ratio.
No-lookahead execution invariant remains true.
stories.prompt_seed: Implement deterministic partial fill behavior and expose fill metadata in API responses.

stories.title: Validate time/adverse flow exits
acceptance: Time exit and adverse flow exit are covered by tests.
Exit reasons are visible in session markers.
stories.prompt_seed: Add/strengthen tests for time_exit and adverse_flow exit behavior.

stories.title: Harden execution config contract
acceptance: All execution config fields are passed runner -> strategy API.
Response includes effective execution_config.
stories.prompt_seed: Verify and harden execution config passthrough between services.

stories.title: Flow-only profile without pattern gate
acceptance: Flow strategy can execute with no detected candlestick patterns.
Pattern layer remains optional.
stories.prompt_seed: Optimize multi-layer logic for flow-first execution where pattern gate is disabled.

stories.title: Extend microstructure feature surface
acceptance: Metrics include large trader activity and VWAP execution flow.
Regime update payload includes these metrics.
stories.prompt_seed: Add and wire additional microstructure metrics into regime and decision payloads.

stories.title: Flow strategy param grids
acceptance: Flow strategies appear in optimization parameter grids.
OOS validator handles flow strategy overrides.
stories.prompt_seed: Add flow strategies to tuning/OOS parameter search.

stories.title: Improve 60/20/20 OOS reporting
acceptance: Report shows split dates and metrics for all buckets.
Errors are explicit per ticker.
stories.prompt_seed: Enhance OOS validator output for direct decision making.

stories.title: Monte Carlo risk threshold gate
acceptance: Script emits pass/fail against configurable P95 drawdown threshold.
stories.prompt_seed: Add a machine-checkable risk gate to Monte Carlo simulation.

stories.title: Hourly and weekday ranking
acceptance: Walk-forward report contains hourly and weekday summaries.
stories.prompt_seed: Complete and test time-bucketed performance analytics.

stories.title: Document run/session contracts
acceptance: Field-level contracts documented for start/config endpoints.
stories.prompt_seed: Produce explicit API contract docs for run and session configuration.

stories.title: Decision payload schema tests
acceptance: Schema tests fail on incompatible marker payload changes.
stories.prompt_seed: Add schema-level tests for decision marker payloads.

stories.title: Regime refresh telemetry reasons
acceptance: Payload contains prior/new regime and reason metrics.
stories.prompt_seed: Add explicit reason fields to regime refresh telemetry.

stories.title: Expose execution controls in UI
acceptance: UI can edit execution config and pass it to run start endpoint.
stories.prompt_seed: Add advanced execution/risk controls to run configuration panel.

stories.title: L2 diagnostics panel
acceptance: Panel displays core L2 diagnostics from decision payload.
stories.prompt_seed: Add visual diagnostics for flow metrics and execution quality.

stories.title: Marker drill-down for new exit reasons
acceptance: Marker details support partial_take_profit and adverse_flow exits.
stories.prompt_seed: Extend marker detail renderer for new exit/cost fields.
